aboutIntro: Folia is a design and supply studio based in Podgorica, Montenegro. We work with restaurants, hotels, bars, and cafés on the details their guests see and use.
aboutProject: Sometimes a project begins with a new menu cover. Sometimes it’s a complete menu redesign, a hotel guest folder, a QR menu, or a new website.
aboutProcess: We help you make those decisions together, from layout and typography to materials and finishing. We coordinate with production partners for the physical pieces and develop digital presentation around the same identity.
aboutCareText: Each venue has its own way of welcoming people. Your presentation should feel like yours.
